title: Query Performance Budget Compiler
description: Compiles per-feature query performance budgets. Enforces: all workload classes defined, transaction durations within spec, replica timeouts are tighter than primary timeouts, declared latency is within SLA, and no vague (non-numeric) timeout values.

error_codes.QPB001: query-performance-budget.json missing or invalid — required fields: workload_classes[], sla{}, budgets[]
error_codes.QPB002: Not all workload classes are defined — every declared query type (OLTP, OLAP, batch, migration) must have a budget entry
error_codes.QPB003: Transaction duration exceeds maximum allowed — long-running transactions hold locks and block vacuum
error_codes.QPB004: Replica timeout is not tighter than primary timeout — replica queries must time out sooner to allow primary fallback
error_codes.QPB005: Declared latency budget exceeds SLA — the query performance budget must fit within the declared service-level objective
error_codes.QPB006: Vague (non-numeric) timeout value found — all timeouts must be expressed as integer milliseconds or seconds
